import sys, time, random, resource; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo, algo
rng=random.Random(3)
N=2048; T=1000; S=1000; Q=1
P = topo.period_rounds(T,S,Q)  # 1
# choose P=128: need P*T % (Q*S)==0 -> 128*1000 % 1000 == 0 -> P=1 is smallest. pick T,S so that P=128
T=1000; S=1000; Q=64  -> Q*S=64000, P=64000/gcd(1000,64000)=64000/1000=64
T=1000;S=125;Q=64 -> Q*S=8000; P=8000/gcd(1000,8000)=8
# choose Q=512, S=1000, T=1000 -> QS=512000, gcd=1000 -> P=512 (too big? N*P=2048*512>262144)
# want P=128 with N=2048: QS/gcd(T,QS)=128
T=1000; S=250; Q=64 -> QS=16000, gcd(1000,16000)=1000 -> P=16
T=1000; S=1000; Q=128 -> QS=128000; gcd=1000 -> P=128 ✓
P=128; Q=128; S=1000; T=1000
print('P',P, 'N*P', N*P)
nlinks=4096
links=[]
ports={}
for i in range(nlinks):
    a=(2*i)%N; b=(2*i+1)%N
    links.append({'ends':[[a,0,0],[b,0,0]],'delay_ns':[rng.randint(1,100),rng.randint(1,100)],'defer_rounds':[rng.randint(0,3),rng.randint(0,3)]})
slices=[[i for i in range(nlinks)] for _ in range(Q)]
fabric={'n':N,'interval_ns':T,'slice_ns':S,'offset_ns':0,
        'drift_ppb':[rng.randint(0,10) for _ in range(N)],
        'heat':[], 'anchors':[[i,0,P] for i in range(0,N,64)],
        'links':links,'slices':slices,'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7],'reconfig_ns':0}
prof={'groups':1,'jitter_ps':[0],'measurements':[]}
print('occurrences', P*len(slices[0]))
t0=time.time(); plan=algo.compile_plan(prof,fabric); t1=time.time()
print('plan time %.1fs'%(t1-t0))
print('peaks', plan['peaks_as'], 'guard', plan['guard_ns'])
print('maxrss MB', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024)
